crime: {WITCH_NAME} kept music or a stream playing in her ears. She told one girl why: when it was quiet, she cried without knowing why and could not stop.
That girl arranged for everyone to fall silent when {WITCH_NAME} entered the dining hall. They watched her break down.

The girl returned from the courtyard through the west corridor last each evening. That night, {WITCH_NAME} tied a cord between the doorframes at the dark end, at throat height. As the girl entered, she sent a crowd of voices advancing from behind her. The girl ran into the darkness, hit the cord with her throat, and fell dead. The voices stopped at once.

Prisoners came with lamps toward the noise so many had heard. There was no crowd: only the body at the far end and {WITCH_NAME} already at the entrance. The sourceless voices had driven the girl straight into the cord. What she had counted on passing for a night's uproar now connected her magic to the trap.
fields.epitaph: She could fill every silence except the one she left behind.
fields.epithet: The Quiet She Could Not Keep
execution: A curved iron shell closed around her, bound at its center. Its low hum was amplified and sent back toward her. Each cry and breath joined it; the sounds she made with magic returned louder still. The noise kept growing until she hung motionless inside the shell.

magic.name: the Static
magic.text: She can fill a place with sounds that have no source and move them at will.
